description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for configuring and transforming Vite build setup within the Playwright component testing framework, including directory resolution, endpoint configuration, component registration, and index file transformation.

methods.name: resolveDirs
methods.description: Resolves the directories for component templates, cache, and config based on the project configuration.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs the server endpoint configuration including host, port, and protocol based on the project config.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vite configuration object with custom settings, including support for JSX and framework plugins.

methods.name: populateComponentsFromTests
methods.description: Populates a component registry with imported component info from test data.

methods.name: hasJSComponents
methods.description: Checks if any components in the list are JavaScript components based on their import paths.

methods.name: transformIndexFile
methods.description: Transforms index files to include React import statements or component import registration code.

methods.name: frameworkConfig
methods.description: Retrieves framework-specific configuration from the full project config.
